1936, August
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 134
Aug. 4 Mrs. & Mr. Avery non C. - Bapt. & Lutheran - married 22 yrs .- she promised our Bl. Mother to go to holy Mass every Sunday if a favor were granted - got the favor.
Mrs. Edna Zyla - 38 - presbiterian - slipped and dislocated her left hip when only 4 or 5 yrs. was treated for rhumatism (small town)
6 Mrs. Emma Feeny - 51 - liver cancer. Caroline Messerang - 79 - fractured hip.
Mrs. Matilda Von Walligan - 40 - ulcers and colitis. Husband never goes to Ch. - drinks - curses - etc.
Nestor & Vincent Law - 15 & 17 ... . disobedient. ...
John Rademacher - 17 - wants to continue in Cath. high School (St. Bernard's) Mother wants him to go to a public school (Cass) She has raised him a Cath. as promised ....
Page 135 Aug. 19 Ralph (Baby) Cozall - 2 - injured at birth cannot. sit up. Stanley Endres - 21 - ruptured - operation in Pt. Huron To-mor .... Mrs. Helen Bejin - 31 fearful headaches. ..
Leo Reilly - 44 - Separation!
Mrs. Ann Burbano - 40 - from S. America - Columbia - came here a year ago looking for her husband. She had two children and had not heard from their father for over a yr. Now finds no trace of him. He was a good man.
Pelga Denolf - 67 - suffering all over her body - now four years .. ·
Mrs. M. Schwab - 60 - threatened with breast cancer - has two chil- dren to . Page 136 Aug. 18 Mrs. Jean Clark - 58 - abcess on lung size of large base-ball - this was last September. To-day first time out in over a year comes to Monaster ... looking well and decidedly hopeful. Has not been paying attention to doctors.
